sci-repo-y8-aran-2015-chemend-mc-1.title: Year 8 Science — Chemistry end-topic test — Aranmore 2015 (original source MC)
sci-repo-y8-aran-2015-chemend-mc-1.coverage: Original assessment questions with source figures. Written parts remain in the bank with marks and parent context. Review-required items excluded from automatic battles.

questions.prompt: The third shell in an atom holds:
questions.explanation: The full third electron shell has a maximum capacity of 18 electrons. The simplified first-20-elements model fills it only to eight before the 4s shell starts.

options: A nucleus containing neutrons and protons, surrounded by a cloud of electrons.
Central neutrons, surrounded by a cloud of electrons and protons.
Central electrons, surrounded by a cloud of protons.
A mixture of protons and electrons spread evenly in a space.
questions.explanation: An atom has protons and neutrons in its nucleus, with electrons around it (except the common hydrogen-1 nucleus has no neutron).

questions.prompt: Electrons can be described as having:
options: A negative charge and negligible mass.
A negative charge and huge mass.
A positive charge and negligible mass.
questions.explanation: Electrons have negative charge and a very small mass compared with protons/neutrons; their mass is not literally zero.

questions.prompt: The nucleus of the atom contains
questions.explanation: The nucleus contains almost all the atomic mass.

questions.prompt: Analyse the word equation: methane + oxygen → carbon dioxide + water + energy This reaction shows that:
options: oxygen is a product of this reaction.
methane burns with a sooty flame.
a constant input of energy is required to keep the reaction going.
questions.explanation: Energy appears among the outputs, identifying an exothermic reaction.

questions.prompt: Which of the following would indicate an endothermic reaction.
options: the reaction feels cold to the touch
questions.explanation: Cooling of the surroundings can indicate heat absorption. Check temperature with suitable equipment rather than touching an unknown reaction.

questions.prompt: A statement that indicates what the expected result of an experiment will be is called a/an:
questions.explanation: A hypothesis is a testable prediction/explanation of the expected result.

questions.prompt: Rodney wanted to know if his new fertilizer would make his fruit trees produce more fruit. He gave 10 tree the new fertilizer.  He gave 10 other trees no fertilizer.  At the end of the year he measured the Mass of fruit produced.  The dependent variable in this experiment was:
questions.explanation: Mass of fruit produced is measured as the dependent variable.

questions.prompt: On the periodic table metal elements are:
questions.explanation: A is the best listed location: metals occupy the left and much of the centre of the periodic table.
